text.tspan: refresh updates the STATE; plan proposes changes to the INFRA
Risk: wrong region / creds → objects look gone
3 · Print the action list: + create, ~ update,
refresh answers "what does the cloud look like now?" and writes it down.
plan answers "what would apply do?" and writes nothing. Since 0.15.4, plan and apply refresh automatically.
